user.title: Connect to Keenetic Router
user.description: Enter the connection details for your Keenetic router.

data_description.host: The hostname or IP address of your Keenetic router.
data_description.port: The port number (default: 80 for HTTP, 443 for HTTPS).
data_description.use_ssl: Enable HTTPS connection to the router.
data_description.verify_ssl: Verify the SSL certificate (disable for self-signed certificates).

error.auth_failed: Authentication failed. Please check your username and password.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the router. Please check the host and port.
error.timeout: Connection timed out. Please check if the router is reachable.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred. Please check the logs for details.
